grounded_in_real_data.per_child_intake: bootstrap resampled from 653 measured subject-days, Sri Lanka dietary recall survey
grounded_in_real_data.camp_size: bootstrap resampled from 78 real IDMC Sri Lankan event figures, capped at 2000
grounded_in_real_data.age_structure: Census of Population and Housing 2012 (DCS), 28 % under 18, 12 % aged 60+, with Dirichlet camp-to-camp variation
grounded_in_real_data.pregnancy: 4.4 % of women 15-49, from the crude birth rate

assumed.adult_and_elderly_intake: The survey covers ages 6-14 only. Adult and elderly means come from the rate table; their spread is a gamma with the children's MEASURED coefficient of variation (0.420). This is the one invented element of the label.

valid_uses: Learning demand VARIANCE: prediction intervals, buffer stock sizing
Testing the pipeline end to end at realistic scale
invalid_uses: Any claim about accuracy of the mean — the mean is put in by construction
Any claim about real Sri Lankan camp consumption
